hypothesis.statement: planning-api is deliberately scaled to zero replicas, so nothing serves plan reads or publication.
feature-service issues far more SQL per build than normal, slowing builds and loading PostgreSQL.
feature-service builds are failing (cause not established by metrics alone).
feature-service is being refused by PostgreSQL with password authentication failures while its builds fail.
forecast-service is being OOM-killed and restarting (the reason for the memory pressure is not established).
Inference slowed after the serving model changed without a restart.
The grid-telemetry feed is being rejected by ingestion while weather ingestion is healthy.
Demand values arriving from grid-telemetry are implausible (e.g. unit change) while ingestion succeeds.
The primary weather vendor's observation feed is failing.
The primary weather vendor repeats identical values with fresh timestamps.
